target_profile.system_boundary: The supplied github.com/hashicorp/raft library source, including its built-in implementations when selected. Application FSM behavior and external storage adapters are interface boundaries. Their injection points and the currently selected implementations have not yet been inspected.
protocol_contexts: A Raft instance maintains role, current term, log indexes and configurations.
A commitment object is documented as belonging to one leader tenure and is initialized with a start index and voter configuration.
Protocol versions affect membership-log encoding; appendConfigurationEntry uses deprecated peer encoding below version 2.
Candidate execution optionally uses pre-vote and bypasses it for leadership-transfer candidacy.
FSM processing and snapshot work use channels and futures distinct from protocol processing.
external_interfaces: Transport: RPC consumption, AppendEntries, pipelining, RequestVote, InstallSnapshot, heartbeat callback and TimeoutNow.
FSM, optional BatchingFSM and observed ConfigurationStore callback selection.
Log storage calls: StoreLogs, GetLog, FirstIndex, LastIndex and DeleteRange; the interface and selected implementation remain unread.
Snapshot storage calls: List, Open and Create; SnapshotSink Close and Cancel.
Client Apply, ApplyLog, Barrier and VerifyLeader futures.
Observer types expose role, peer and heartbeat events; delivery implementation remains unread.
ownership: runCandidate handles protocol RPCs, vote results, election timing and client rejection while in Candidate state.
commitment protects match indexes and its commit index with a mutex.
processLogs schedules work to the FSM owner through fsmMutateCh.
runFSM owns local application index and term variables and selects single or batch callbacks.
takeSnapshot requests FSM state and separately requests configuration state from the main thread.
FileSnapshotSink owns file finalization, directory publication and retention calls.
selection_injection: runFSM selects BatchingFSM and ConfigurationStore through type assertions on r.fsm.
Transport may support a heartbeat fast path or use its Consumer channel; activation and callback ownership remain unread.
The constructor and deployment selections are unread; caller injection must not be interpreted as excluding repository implementations.
FileSnapshotSink is an observed repository implementation. Catalogue entries identify additional in-memory and discard snapshot implementations, but their behavior and activation remain unread.
README names separately maintained storage adapters; those statements do not identify the adapter selected by this target.
variants: Single FSM application versus BatchingFSM application.
ConfigurationStore implemented versus absent in the single-application path.
Pre-vote enabled versus disabled or bypassed for leadership transfer.
Protocol version below 2 versus version 2 or above for configuration entry encoding.
Startup FSM restoration enabled versus NoSnapshotRestoreOnStart.
File snapshot synchronization enabled versus noSync; parent-directory synchronization also differs on Windows.
Normal trailing-log compaction versus removal of all old logs for callers using monotonic stores.
unknowns: Constructor selection, startup sequencing, stable-state restoration and actual configured adapters.
Concrete persistence guarantees, partial-write behavior and error semantics of the selected stores.
Replication, heartbeat and pipeline result validation and their interaction with authority changes.
RPC-handler behavior, leader commit consumption and membership admission serialization.
Application callback implementations and deployment-specific fault assumptions.
Exact repository revision and dependency versions beyond the supplied snapshot identity.

activities.purpose: Form replication support and advance local decision progress.
activities.realization_summary: commitment aggregates increasing reports for current voters and advances its index using an order statistic and start-index threshold. dispatchLogs reports local storage success. Remote report establishment and the leader's consumer of the resulting index remain unread.
variants: Voter-set replacement retains reports for surviving voter IDs.
unknowns: Replication acknowledgment validation and commit-index consumption.

activities.realization_summary: runCandidate performs pre-vote or election, processes higher-term responses, counts granted responses, invokes role transitions and rejects leader-only requests. Vote producers, term persistence and transition helper implementations remain unread.
unknowns: Vote identity correlation, election initiation, follower timeouts, leader lease and transfer completion.

activities.purpose: Restore replica state and resume processing from retained evidence.
activities.realization_summary: Startup restoration selects a snapshot, optionally restores the FSM and installs snapshot and configuration metadata. runFSM has a separate restore closure. Network snapshot installation and incremental catch-up remain deferred.
unknowns: Startup callers, incremental replay, InstallSnapshot handler and restore serialization.

activities.purpose: Construct, activate and recover participant configurations.
activities.realization_summary: appendConfigurationEntry computes a configuration, dispatches its log and updates latest configuration, commitment voters and replication ownership. Startup snapshots restore committed and latest configuration. Admission and commitment transitions are unread.
unknowns: nextConfiguration validation, concurrent-change admission and committed-configuration updates.

activities.purpose: Schedule decided entries and turn them into application callbacks.
activities.realization_summary: processLogs prepares indexed entries and sends batches to runFSM. runFSM filters types, invokes single or batch callbacks and responds to associated futures. The library owns scheduling; application state semantics are supplied through FSM interfaces.
unknowns: prepareLog filtering, channel receive loop and restore/snapshot ordering.

activities.purpose: Persist, publish, retain and reclaim protocol history.
activities.realization_summary: Observed paths include local StoreLogs, snapshot capture requests, Persist and Close, file publication, retention invocation and log deletion. Adapter guarantees and snapshot capture establishment remain incomplete.
unknowns: Snapshot capture producer, metadata writing, listing and retention implementations, storage durability.

activities.purpose: Admit client operations and distinguish submission, application and completion.
activities.realization_summary: ApplyLog and Barrier enqueue futures with optional enqueue timeout and shutdown alternatives. VerifyLeader uses a separate channel. FSM processing supplies application responses, while API comments explicitly preserve ambiguity after leadership loss.
unknowns: Future synchronization, leader-side admission, verification completion and caller retry or deduplication semantics.
